SELECT p.user_id AS studentId, u.nickname AS studentName, u.username AS studentUsername, p.teacher_id AS teacherId, tu.nickname AS teacherName, (SELECT m.content FROM psy_chat_message m WHERE m.student_id = p.user_id ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastMessage, (SELECT m.sender_role FROM psy_chat_message m WHERE m.student_id = p.user_id ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastSenderRole, (SELECT m.create_time FROM psy_chat_message m WHERE m.student_id = p.user_id ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM psy_chat_message m WHERE m.student_id = p.user_id AND m.sender_role = 'student' AND m.is_read = 0) AS unread, IFNULL(cv.status, '待处理') AS status, IFNULL(cv.pinned, 0) AS pinned, cv.remark AS remark FROM psy_patient p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON p.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user tu ON p.teacher_id = tu.user_id LEFT JOIN psy_chat_conversation cv ON cv.student_id = p.user_id WHERE p.user_id IS NOT NULL
AND (p.teacher_id = #{teacherId} OR p.teacher_id IS NULL)
ORDER BY pinned DESC, unread DESC, COALESCE(lastTime, p.create_time) DESC

SELECT p.teacher_id AS teacherId, COALESCE(NULLIF(tu.nickname, ''), tu.username) AS teacherName FROM psy_patient p LEFT JOIN sys_user tu ON p.teacher_id = tu.user_id WHERE p.user_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1

SELECT p.user_id AS studentId, u.nickname AS studentName, u.username AS studentUsername, p.teacher_id AS teacherId, COALESCE(NULLIF(tu.nickname, ''), tu.username) AS teacherName FROM psy_patient p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON p.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user tu ON p.teacher_id = tu.user_id WHERE p.user_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id, c.student_id AS studentId, c.sender_id AS senderId, c.sender_role AS senderRole, c.content, c.is_read AS isRead, c.create_time AS createTime, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username) AS senderName FROM psy_chat_message c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.sender_id = u.user_id WHERE c.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY c.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO psy_chat_message (student_id, sender_id, sender_role, content, is_read) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{senderId}, #{senderRole}, #{content}, 0)
